srcset_analysis.status: RE-CONFIRMED — persistent issue across all tested pages (same as reports 0200, 0215, 0230)
srcset_analysis.detail: NO srcset or sizes attributes found on any of the 4 tested pages (Brand, Post Ad, FAQ, How it Works). Only img-fluid CSS class used for responsive images.
srcset_analysis.recommendation: Implement srcset + sizes attributes on: brand logo, product thumbnail images, CMS page decorative elements

footer_consistency.detail: All pages use consistent col-md-6 col-lg-3 footer column pattern (4-col desktop -> 2-col tablet -> 1-col mobile). Footer has 7 column instances.

header_consistency.detail: All pages share the same header structure: header-top + header-bottom__container container-md + ps-mainmenu__desktop for desktop + d-md-none offcanvas mobile menu. Consistent across all 4 pages.

mobile_navigation.detail: Mobile navigation pattern consistent: 7 d-md-none instances (mobile hamburger toggle), 14-25 offcanvas instances (brand page has 25 due to product filters), 5-58 collapse toggles (brand page has 58 for faceted filter accordions).

post_ad_auth_redirect.detail: Post Ad page redirects unauthenticated users to login (5 references to iniciar-sesion/login). This is expected behavior for a listing creation page that requires authentication.

cache_headers.detail: Cache-Control: no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate (expected for dynamic PHP marketplace)

brand_page_product_grid.detail: Brand page (Anayak) renders 24 product miniatures in a grid layout with pagination. Product grid items use Bootstrap grid classes (col-md-6, col-lg-3, col-lg-4) for responsive reflow from 1-col mobile -> 2-col tablet -> 3/4-col desktop. Schema.org Product markup present.

mobile_vs_desktop_structural_parity.detail: Mobile and Desktop user agents receive identical HTML structure (same col-md count: 12, same col-lg count: 11, same d-md-none count: 7). This confirms server-side responsive approach using only CSS media queries (not separate mobile/desktop templates), which is correct.

summary: Responsive structure is CORRECT across all 4 tested pages (Brand, Post Ad, FAQ, How it Works). ALL pages have: (1) viewport meta tag width=device-width initial-scale=1, (2) Bootstrap 5 responsive grid classes (col-md-, col-lg-), (3) mobile-first offcanvas navigation pattern with d-md-none mobile toggle, (4) responsive footer with col-md-6 col-lg-3 4-col -> 2-col -> 1-col pattern, (5) breadcrumb navigation, (6) hreflang i18n tags. KEY FINDINGS: (1) Brand page shows 24 product miniatures with responsive grid + pagination, (2) Post Ad page has extensive form (30 form-control, 12 text, 6 textarea, 3 radio, file upload) + auth redirect for unregistered users, (3) CMS pages (FAQ, How It Works) have proper CMS content layout, (4) Mobile and Desktop receive identical HTML structure confirming proper CSS-responsive approach. RE-CONFIRMED persistent issue: No srcset/sizes on images (RESP-SRCSET-01). No new responsive issues detected.
